newsitem.title: USA: Investors urge Baldwin to explore options.
newsitem.headline: Investors urge Baldwin to explore options.

text.p: An investment group holding a 6.5 percent stake in Baldwin Piano and Organ Co said it had asked the company's board to explore a possible sale or merger.
Bolero Investment Group LP said in a letter to Baldwin that the company had failed to address slow sales, erratic earnings and poor stock performance.
Bolero also said it has raised its stake in Baldwin to 6.5 percent, representing an 18 percent increase since July.
If the company fails to hire an investment banker to explore alternatives, Bolero said it will make that proposal at the company's annual meeting.
Loveland, Ohio-based Baldwin had no immediate comment on the group's demand.
Shares of Baldwin were down 1/4 at 15-3/4.
